body_lead: AHMEDABAD: In a first for India, the Gujarat Police has deployed an AI-powered weapon against drug crime. NARIT AI is a smart investigation tool designed to tighten NDPS cases, eliminate procedural loopholes, and sharply boost conviction rates. Built on cutting-edge Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, the system doesn’t just assist, it interrogates every FIR, dissects every loophole, and rebuilds every case with precision, turning routine investigations into courtroom-ready prosecutions.
